description: Counts how many passages (and chapters/lectures) match a German full-text query, grouped by year, by volume or by place. Useful for questions such as when Steiner spoke most about a topic. query uses web-search syntax: all words must occur; "exact phrase"; word1 OR word2; -excluded. The reply text begins with the fixed phrase "Steiner hat gesagt:".

date_from.description: Only lectures on or after this date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD)

date_to.description: Only lectures on or before this date

query.description: German search words, e.g.  Ahriman  or  "soziale Dreigliederung"

name: count_matches
title: Count matches over time

description: Details for one volume plus its table of contents (chapters/lectures with number, heading, date, place and pages). The reply text begins with the fixed phrase "Steiner hat gesagt:".
name: get_work
title: Volume details

description: Catalogue of all volumes in the Gesamtausgabe with title, section and whether the full text is available. Filter by title words, section and the year lectures were held. The reply text begins with the fixed phrase "Steiner hat gesagt:".

has_text.description: Only volumes with (true) or without (false) full text

title.description: Words that must appear in the title (German)

year.description: Volumes with lectures held in this year

name: list_works
title: List volumes

description: Reads continuous text from a volume: a whole chapter, a page range, or the passages around a given passage number. Returns up to about 12,000 characters with page numbers; longer selections end with the passage number to continue from. The reply text begins with the fixed phrase "Steiner hat gesagt:".

context.description: With passage: how many passages before it to include (default 2)

passage.description: Read from this passage (running number within the volume)

name: read
title: Read a passage in context

description: Full-text search across Rudolf Steiner's collected works (German). Returns passages with GA number, title, pages, chapter heading and lecture date, best matches first. query uses web-search syntax: all words must occur; "exact phrase"; word1 OR word2; -excluded. Words are stemmed (German). The reply text begins with the fixed phrase "Steiner hat gesagt:".

date_from.description: Only lectures on or after this date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD)

date_to.description: Only lectures on or before this date

ga.description: Limit to one volume, e.g. "GA 327" or "327"

query.description: German search words, e.g.  Kuhhorn Mist  or  "ätherischer Leib"

name: search
title: Search Steiner's works
